description: Processed EK80 echosounder data (18, 38, 70, 120 and 200 kHz) from the Icelandic part of the International Ecosystem Summer Survey in Nordic Seas (IESSNS), 5-26 July 2021, R/V Árni Friðriksson. One Item per day, with Sv, denoised, masked and pruned Sv, MVBS and NASC as Zarr, denoising statistics and echograms. Processed by OceanStream on MareNostrum 5 (EuroHPC ehpc812) from the raw files published on PANGAEA. Calibration from the survey's calibration file; sound speed and absorption from the environment settings recorded in the raw files. In MVBS and NASC, cells below the noise count as zero (-999 dB in MVBS), artefact and seabed cells are left out, and each channel is integrated over its own layer (attribute integration_layers). Source data: Ólafsdóttir, Anna H; Pampoulie, Christophe (2025): Acoustic data from IESSNS north, northeast, south and west of Iceland in July 2021 [dataset]. PANGAEA, https://doi.org/10.1594/PANGAEA.975782 (CC BY 4.0).
